subject: Kickoff: Orbit Analytics Redwood tenant & API access
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Park <andrea@orbitanalytics.com>, Mike Thompson <mike@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Orbit Analytics Redwood tenant & API access

Hi Andrea / Mike —

Thanks again for the quick intro call today. Per our discussion, attaching a lightweight initial plan to get your tenant provisioned, admin invites out, and API keys seeded so your devs can hit the service within 48 hours of signoff. High-level next steps below — I added owners on each line.

- Provision Redwood workspace (we create the project namespace and default roles) — owner: Soojin (Redwood)
- Seed service API key(s) and generate per-environment roles (prod/staging/dev) — owner: Soojin
- Invite initial admin users (CS will provide list in CSV) — owner: Orbit (Andrea)
- Set billing seat count and reserved capacity request (optional) — owner: Ben (Redwood)
- Security checklist: customer KMS/GCP IAM integration vs. Redwood-managed keys — owner: Karthik (Redwood) + Orbit Sec team

Please confirm the admin invite list as a CSV (see template attached) and whether you want Redwood to manage keys or provide a KMS path. If you prefer a single shared service key to start, we can seed that and rotate to per-project keys later.

Attachments: orbit_initial_mtp.pdf (one-page timeline), redwood-invite-template.csv

Proposed kickoff slot: Monday 2029-05-20 09:00 PT (45m) — I’ll reserve that unless you prefer a different time.

Thanks,
Soojin
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Soojin Lee | soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

1) We will provide an admin list; can you confirm the maximum number of initial admin seats included in the onboarding?
2) For keys: we'd prefer Redwood-managed keys to move faster, but Orbit security will want to enable KMS in prod once we validate. Can we start with Redwood-managed and then switch to our KMS later?

I attached a preliminary admin list in the body below (names masked) — we’ll send the CSV by EOD Monday. Monday 9am PT works for Andrea / Mike.

Andrea — thanks for the quick reply and confirmation. To answer:

- Initial admin seats for onboarding: we include up to 6 admin invites in the standard onboarding bundle. Additional seats can be added; Ben will follow up separately on pricing if you need more.
- Key approach: yes — we can seed a Redwood-managed service key for dev/staging and then perform a KMS handoff for prod. Migration path is tested and documented.

I’ve created the tenant namespace ORBIT-analytics-prod-staging on our staging cluster so you can start running smoke tests after invites go out. Next actions from our side:

1) I will seed two keys (staging service key + dev service key) and upload the invite template to the shared drive.
2) Ben will confirm billing seat changes if you request more than 6 admins.
3) Karthik will reach out with the KMS onboarding checklist if you want to proceed with customer-managed keys in prod.

Attaching scope-and-roles-v1.docx for a suggested role matrix (admins, billing, dev, readonly).

Shared Drive link: https://redwood.app/drive/ORB-123-kickoff-plan

I’ll post the seeded key IDs in this thread once created. Meeting invite for Mon 9:00 PT sent.

Best,
Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Orbit Analytics Redwood tenant & API access

Quick note on seats/pricing — Andrea, if you anticipate >6 admins for the first 30 days, we can include up to 12 by default for onboarding under the same initial term; otherwise additional seats are billed monthly. For reserved capacity: if you want predictable throughput for inference-heavy tests, we recommend a short trial of a small Dedicated pool.

If you’re good with the 6-seat start, no action required. If you want 12, reply-all and I’ll raise the change order (ORBIT-DO-27) and push a short amendment to the Docusign flow.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

All — great kickoff today, really appreciated the clarity from Andrea and Mike. Summary of agreed actions and owners (to preserve momentum):

- Orbit to send final admin CSV by EOD Tuesday (Andrea) — Redwood will process invites within 4 business hours of receipt (Soojin).
- Redwood to seed staging/dev service keys and post key IDs in this thread (Soojin) — expected by Tue 10:00 PT.
- If Orbit opts into customer-managed KMS for prod, Karthik will run the KMS handoff checklist and schedule a short migration window; target after initial smoke tests.
- Ben to hold on seat amendment unless Andrea confirms 12-seat ask by Tue EOD.
- ZenCloud (cc) to confirm any cross-account network CIDR allowlist needed for the Dedicated trial (ZenCloud ops team).

Open question: Orbit requested a single shared service key vs. per-project keys. Recommendation: start shared for staging/dev, then switch to per-project keys in prod. If anyone on this thread needs a technical deep-dive on the key rotation plan, Karthik and I will host a 30m session.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the invite processing update.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
